title: Put an invoice on hold
body:
Finance wants to pause collection on an invoice while they sort something out with the customer.

Add `hold_invoice(invoice_id)` to `parcelo/invoices.py`. It sets the invoice status to "on_hold", stores the time it was put on hold in a new `held_at` field on `Invoice` (in `parcelo/models.py`), and returns the invoice.

Only open invoices can be put on hold. An invoice that does not exist must fail.
